Owning an Ather

Ather Grid fast charging: a practical guide

Ather Grid is India's largest fast-charging network for two-wheelers, with more than 6,100 points across 370+ cities. For most owners it is a safety net rather than a daily habit — but knowing how it works makes long days and trips much easier.

Updated 12 November 2026 · 2 min read · Pillai Auto, authorised Ather dealer

Ather Grid fast charging: a practical guide

On this page

  1. How much range in ten minutes
  2. Finding a charger
  3. Using a fast charger
  4. When to use Grid, and when not to

How much range in ten minutes

Model and batteryRange added in 10 minutes
450X 3.5 kWh, 450 Apex, Rizta Z 3.5 kWhup to 30 km
450X / Rizta Z smaller battery, 450S, Rizta Sup to 15 km
Konarc S 2.7 / 3.5 kWhup to 15 km
Konarc S 2.1 kWhup to 13 km (Grid access is an add-on)

Finding a charger

The Ather app shows nearby Ather Grid points with live availability, and on models with Google Maps the dashboard can route you to one. Ather Grid points also appear in Google Maps. Before a long trip, open the app and note two chargers along the way — a primary and a backup — rather than relying on one.

Using a fast charger

  1. Park so the cable reaches without strain, and switch the scooter off.
  2. Connect the charger and start the session from the app or the charger, following the on-screen steps.
  3. Watch the charge on your app; you do not need to stand by the scooter.
  4. Unplug and move on as soon as you have what you need — the next rider may be waiting.

When to use Grid, and when not to

Fast charging is perfect for topping up during a long day or a trip. For everyday charging, home charging overnight is cheaper and gentler on the battery. A good habit: charge at home daily, use Grid when the day runs longer than planned. For long routes in our region, see the ECR trip guide and the Chengalpattu commute guide.

Questions we get asked

Ather lists more than 6,100 fast-charging points across 370+ cities in India.

Up to 30 km of range in ten minutes on the 3.5 kWh 450X, 450 Apex and Rizta Z, and up to 15 km on most other variants.

Yes, the Konarc S 2.7 and 3.5 kWh variants support Ather Grid. On the 2.1 kWh variant it is an add-on.
